events.description: Called when the user presses the clear button; the app empties the selection.
events.name: onClearSelection

events.description: Called with true when the user chooses all matching records and with false when they go back to the rows shown.
events.name: onAllMatchingSelectedChange

props.description: How many records are selected on screen; with `isAllMatchingSelected` the bar reads `totalCount` instead.
props.name: selectedCount

props.description: The actions on the selection, in order; the handler of each closes over the selected keys.
props.name: actions

props.description:
True when every record on screen is selected. "Select all N" is offered only then, and only with `totalCount`
above the selected count. Left out it is false, so a bar used on its own never offers the choice.
props.name: isPageSelected

props.description: The spoken name of the bar, for example "Order actions". Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: label

props.description: Writes the count as a sentence, for example "3 selected"; it is announced politely. Defaults to English.
props.name: countLabel

props.description: The text of the clear button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's word in the active locale.
props.name: clearLabel

props.description: Writes the "select all matching" button, for example "Select all 245". Defaults to English.
props.name: selectAllLabel

props.description: Writes the button that goes back to the rows shown, for example "Select only the 20 shown". Defaults to English.
props.name: selectShownLabel

props.description: The accessible name of the native overflow button; web draws every action and has no overflow.
props.name: moreActionsLabel

props.description: How many records match the query across all pages, when the server says. Left out, "select all" is not offered.
props.name: totalCount

props.description: True when the user chose every matching record; the bar then reads `totalCount` as the selected count.
props.name: isAllMatchingSelected

props.description:
`inline` (the default) sits above the list it acts on; `floating` is a pill fixed to the foot of the content
column on the overlay surface, taking no room, so nothing shifts as rows are picked (ADR 0501).
props.name: variant
